coverage_limits: Source existence and exact mention do not establish meaning or co-reference.
Model statement status and threshold classification may be wrong; date arithmetic is not independently verified.
Document admissibility, corporate succession, statutory version and exceptions are not executed.
Empty combinations are not absence in reality.
model_coverage_limits: The record narrates a family arrangement and alleged partition but does not contain a court finding establishing the legal mode of transfer (sub-letting, assignment, or parting with possession) or the form of consent (written vs oral). The distinction between joint business and separate possession is narrated but not adjudicated in the provided text. No explicit finding on the validity of the lease or consent clause is present.
